title: Surrogate-assisted global sensitivity analysis of a hybrid-dimensional Stokes--Brinkman--Darcy model
summary: Development of new multiscale mathematical models often entails considerable complexity and multiple undetermined parameters, typically arising from closure relations. To enable reliable simulations, one must quantify how uncertain physical parameters influence model predictions. We propose surrogate-assisted global sensitivity analysis that combines computational efficiency with a rigorous assessment of parameter influence.
